item.title: 【Off-Topic】OLD FILES
item.description:
Surely someone still has old files saved on an hdd, cd, dvd, pen drive or cloud. I'm not the only one looking for these old videos. Please consider sharing what you have. Are we really going to let sharemania swimming in the trash bin?



Can you watch these pixelated yt videos without complaining? Some videos aren't even available in lq. It's like they never existed.

Don't be selfish, start helping each other. If you don't like me, fine, but help. If it depended on liking someone or not, I wouldn't share anything. I even do what I "shouldnt", get myself burned with most of the users, but I share the fucking prores files, whatever it is.

Without all the cappers, you guys wouldn't have anything.
item.author: NEOMBEONAIN
